2.264.5
MapViewport.MapCoordinateSystem
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.MapCoordinateSystem element specifies the map coordinate system for a Map
element. The MapViewport.MapCoordinateSystem element is optional.
If this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an
expression that evaluates to a String. The value of this element MUST be one of the following or an
expression that evaluates to one of the following:
Planar: The planar coordinate system is used.
Geographic: The geographic coordinate system is used.
If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "Planar".
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.MapCoordinateSystem element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.MapCoordinateSystem element.
 <xsd:element name="MapCoordinateSystem" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
